column9: API-key destination creation always fails in non-interactive mode: appleApiKeyId starts undefined and is absent from the options schema, so callers cannot supply the required value. The command uploads the .p8 key and then exits without creating a destination. Add an appleApiKeyId option and read it before uploading.
The app-specific password uses a text prompt, exposing the credential on screen and in terminal recordings or scrollback. Use a masked password prompt for this secret.

The certificate password is collected through an unmasked text prompt, exposing signing credentials on screen and in terminal recordings or scrollback. The key-password prompt at line 139 has the same issue; both should mask their input.
